CorePlan.note: Core org plan: icon tile, success status badge, manage + refill actions, the 3-up PCU metric row, the 2-up sandbox/repo row, the usage bar and the Credit top up block.

FreePlan.note: Free personal plan with the neutral badge and the Upgrade to Core primary action; overageSummary correctly returns null so no top-up block.

WithGrantBreakdown.note: grantAllocations populated, so proliferateCreditBalance sums the grants and CreditGrantBreakdown renders per-grant bars under the metrics.

CreditsExhausted.note: Exhausted balance: 0 PCUs available, saturated usage bar, Credit top up Off, plus the destructive actionError Notice. Deliberately uses billingMode 'observe' to keep the unreadable tone="warning" start-block Notice out of the sheet (DS token defect, see learnings/F.md).

LoadFailed.note: The error branch is intentionally a single SettingsRow + Retry — sparse by design, and it renders exactly that.
